content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make coffee icing, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sift the powdered sugar (3 minutes)
Step 2. Whisk the vanilla extract into the base (30 seconds)
Step 3. Soften the unsalted butter (45 minutes)
Step 4. Wipe down the mixing bowl (1 minute)
Step 5. Dissolve the instant coffee granules in hot water (2 minutes)
Step 6. Boil a small amount of water (5 minutes)
Step 7. Measure out the heavy cream (1 minute)
Step 8. Weigh the cocoa powder for a mocha tint (2 minutes)
Step 9. Retrieve the espresso powder from the pantry (1 minute)
Step 10. Prepare the piping bag with a star tip (4 minutes)
Step 11. Chill the heavy cream (20 minutes)
Step 12. Sterilize the whisk attachment (3 minutes)
Step 13. Organize the workstation (5 minutes)
Step 14. Wash the measuring spoons (2 minutes)
Step 15. Dry the whisk attachment thoroughly (1 minute)
Step 16. Combine espresso powder with the coffee liquid (1 minute)
Step 17. Sift the cocoa powder to remove lumps (2 minutes)
Step 18. Clear space on the kitchen counter (2 minutes)
Step 19. Open the cocoa powder container (30 seconds)
Step 20. Cream the butter and sugar together (8 minutes)
Step 21. Add the coffee mixture to the butter base (1 minute)
Step 22. Temper the coffee liquid to room temperature (10 minutes)
Step 23. Buy fresh ingredients at the store (1 hour)
Step 24. Measure the vanilla extract (1 minute)
Step 25. Take the butter out of the refrigerator (5 minutes)
Step 26. Mix the coffee and butter on low speed (3 minutes)
Step 27. Unpack the groceries (5 minutes)
Step 28. Check the expiration date on the cream (30 seconds)
Step 29. Measure the powdered sugar (2 minutes)
Step 30. Pour the cream into a small pitcher (1 minute)
Step 31. Set out the mixing bowls (2 minutes)
Step 32. Wash the mixing bowl (3 minutes)
Step 33. Clean the cream measuring cup (2 minutes)
Step 34. Sanitize the countertop (5 minutes)
Step 35. Locate the coffee concentrate (1 minute)
Step 36. Scrape down the sides of the bowl (1 minute)
Step 37. Inspect the vanilla bean quality (1 minute)
Step 38. Dispose of the cream packaging (30 seconds)
Step 39. Blend the vanilla into the mixture (2 minutes)
Step 40. Fill the piping bag with finished icing (3 minutes)
